instruction: How many activities are left to do in my bucket list as per my SimpleNote note?
notes: Read-only question task: no database changes are allowed, so every action is a lookup. The agent discovers passwords, logs into SimpleNote, searches notes with query 'bucket list' to learn the note id (known-id), reads the note content with show_note to count the activities still left to do (found-remaining-count), and passes that count as the answer to supervisor.complete_task, which is forced to be last via (task-completed). The static facts note-matches and answer-of only tie the placeholder objects to the note; the actual count is computed from the note content at runtime.
